about_the_game:
The Untold Story of Pandora’s Box

Everyone knows the classic myth—Pandora opened a box and unleashed misery upon the world. But few know the truth: who really appeared before her in Zeus’ guise, what ancient terror escaped, how the Titan Iapetus broke free, and what price Greek heroes paid to stop Chaos’ invasion. Epos Survivors lets you relive these events alongside legendary warriors. Slash through hordes of enemies, tackle diverse challenges solo or with friends, and survive endless waves of foes. Crush your enemies with expertly crafted dash effects, overpowered auto-attacks, carefully synergized autocast skills, and devastating overlock combos—or dominate through seamless co-op play. The choice is yours.

Key Features:

✔ Satisfying Combat – Wreck endless waves of diverse enemies.
✔ Dynamic Campaign – Take on varied missions with unique objectives.
✔ Customizable Dash – Stack multiple effects for explosive movement.
✔ Autocast & Synergies – Combine skills for powerful, game-changing builds.
✔ Solo or Co-op – Play alone or team up with friends for chaos-fueled battles.
✔ Unique Enemies – Face mythical beasts, steampunk constructs, and more—each with distinct behaviors.

  • Processor: Intel Core i3-3210
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: DirectX 10 capable GPU
  • DirectX: Version 10
  • Storage: 500 MB available space

Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 or newer
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-4690 or higher
  • Memory: 8 MB RAM
